general_information.Description: This course aims to provide student understanding on techniques, tools and skills to do a practical application design project. To study this course, student must have basic knowledge related to Interaction and UX Design, understanding principles and agile process applied in a mobile design project. In this course, student will perform a design project individually and have to work with programmer to transform an idea to a product. They will learn how to do from a research to design and implement an application project. They will learn about how to run a study of domain interested, how to make use-case list and draw flow diagram. They will be taught about the way to write a proposal for a project. In design phase, there are alot of things student must aware about, so they will be taught about them including rules, principles and good practices such as Realism, Fitts's Law, Animation, Speed and etc.. Testing techniques such as A/B Testing, Usability Testing will also be explained in this course. Student will be evaluated according to how his/her applied knowledge gained from this course to the course's project.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Follow instructions from teachers in class - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. - Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Discuss key aspects of mobile application design and development, including process stages, platform differences, and user interaction models.
Conduct domain-specific research to identify real user problems and develop a research-backed proposal for a mobile application solution.
Create sketches and paper prototypes to explore and communicate early-stage design ideas and user flows.
Build interactive digital prototypes using up-to-date design tools (e.g., Figma, ProtoPie, Framer, or similar), representing realistic app behavior.
Enhance design solutions by applying UI/UX principles, mobile-specific best practices, and visual design guidelines.
Explain and apply evaluation methods in the implementation phase, including usability testing, A/B testing, and remote testing techniques.
Conduct usability testing on mobile prototypes, gather feedback, and derive actionable insights to improve the product.
Manage project tasks collaboratively throughout the full mobile app design process, including coordination with developers and team members.
Present the design process and outcome effectively through well-structured documentation, visual storytelling presentations.
